title: Paige Kaye (PaigeKares founder) on meeting Eric at the SDSU book signing
summary: Paige Kaye — founder & CEO of PaigeKares — meets Eric at the SDSU book signing and walks away with a copy plus a conversation about governance designed to align investors with durable trust rather than short-term profit shortcuts.
blockquote: It was so great to finally meet Eric Ries in person at his book tour for Incorruptible! ... Yes, it's THAT good that I made the time to show up while bootstrapping as a solopreneur.
